title: SCA Minhag of the Week 262: Q&A Wedding Practices: Yihud Room, Mezinke Dance, Going Away & Blessings

chapters.title: Yichud Room
chapters.about: Sephardic view on Yichud and bridal rooms

chapters.title: Going Away Outfits

summary: Mr. Mosseri addresses various wedding practices and clarifies which are not part of the Sephardic tradition. He explains the origins and customs regarding the Yichud room, the Mezinke dance, going away outfits, and the practice of brides and grooms giving blessings.
questions: Is it a Sephardic custom to have a Yichud room?
What is the Mezinke dance and do Sephardim practice it?
Why do people have going away outfits?
Should a bride and groom give blessings to single guests?
